question: The point on the supply curve at which a firm earns only normal profit is called the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Break-even point.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The point on the supply curve at which an enterprise earns only normal profit is known as the **break-even point** of the enterprise.
